playerConnectionWhitelist.summary: Used by the  to determine if a player should be allowed to join the server.              Used in the whitelist.prototype_list CVar.                           Whitelists are used to determine if a player is allowed to connect.              You define a PlayerConnectionWhitelist with a list of conditions.              Every condition has a type and a  along with other parameters depending on the type.              Action must either be Allow, Deny or Next.              Allow means the player is instantly allowed to connect if the condition is met.              Deny means the player is instantly denied to connect if the condition is met.              Next means the next condition in the list is checked.              If the condition doesn't match, the next condition is checked.

fields.name: MinimumPlayers

fields.summary: Category the alert belongs to. Only one alert of a given category             can be shown at a time. If one is shown while another is already being shown,             it will be replaced. This can be useful for categories of alerts which should naturally             replace each other and are mutually exclusive, for example lowpressure / highpressure,             hot / cold. If left unspecified, the alert will not replace or be replaced by any other alerts.

fields.name: MaxSeverity
fields.summary: Maximum severity level supported by this state. -1 (default) indicates             no severity levels are supported by the state.

CEWorkbenchContainerProvider.summary: Provides resources to the workbench located in a container in the same entity.

CEWorkbenchPlaceableProvider.summary: Provides resources to the workbench located on ItemPlacer

CEWorkbenchUserCrafter.summary: This workbench can only operate when there is a user interacting with it.

CEWorkbenchUserContainersProvider.name: CEWorkbenchUserContainersProvider
CEWorkbenchUserContainersProvider.summary: Provides resources to the workbench from the inventory of the player currently using it.             Includes items in hands, equipped clothing/pocket slots, and recursively scans containers.

CEPortalAutoLink.name: CEPortalAutoLink
CEPortalAutoLink.summary: Marks a portal that wants to be auto-linked to another portal carrying the same              at map init time. After a successful pairing, this component             is removed from both ends so it never tries to link again.

fields.name: Key
fields.summary: Free-form pairing key. Two portals with matching keys (and only two) on the             same map will be linked together when their MapInitEvent fires.

CEBlessingStatue.name: CEBlessingStatue
CEBlessingStatue.summary: The main coordinator component placed on a statue entity.             Links to a trigger zone and pedestal tables via EntityLookup on MapInit.             Tracks which players have been offered blessings and manages active blessing entities.

fields.name: LinkRadius
fields.summary: Search radius (in tiles) for linking trigger and tables on initialization.

fields.name: BlessingPrototype
fields.summary: Prototype ID for the blessing entity to spawn on tables.

fields.name: LinkedTables
fields.summary: References to linked table (pedestal) entities, found during initialization.

fields.name: ActivePlayer
fields.summary: The player currently interacting with the statue (offer pending). While non-null             the statue is "occupied" — other players cannot click it.

fields.name: ActiveBlessings
fields.summary: Currently spawned blessing entities on the pedestals for the active player.

fields.name: TriggerRadius
fields.summary: TODO: delete this and use the fixture's actual shape

CEBlessingTable.name: CEBlessingTable
CEBlessingTable.summary: Marker component for pedestal entities that display blessings.             Found by the statue during initialization via EntityLookup.

CEBlessingTrigger.name: CEBlessingTrigger
CEBlessingTrigger.summary: A sensor zone entity (stone platform with runes) placed near a blessing statue.             When a player walks into this zone, the linked statue spawns blessings on pedestals.

CEPlayerDungeonOverview.name: CEPlayerDungeonOverview
CEPlayerDungeonOverview.summary: Marker for entities (e.g. wayfinding stones) that expose the player-facing             dungeon overview UI on .

fields.name: TargetLevel
fields.fullType: System.Nullable`1[[Robust.Shared.Prototypes.ProtoId`1[[Content.Server._CE.Procedural.Prototypes.CEDungeonLevelPrototype, Content.Server, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]], Robust.Shared, Version=275.2.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]

fields.name: SearchRadius
fields.summary: Radius (in tiles) to search for nearby players when forming a group.

fields.name: MaxPlayers
fields.summary: Maximum number of players that can pass through this exit at once.             If more players are nearby, a random subset is chosen.

CEDungeonEntryPoint.name: CEDungeonEntryPoint
CEDungeonEntryPoint.summary: Marks an entity as an entry point inside a generated dungeon instance.             Incoming players materialize at the position of an active entry.             Once used (or after  expires), the entry becomes permanently inactive.

fields.name: Active
fields.summary: Whether this entry point can still accept incoming players.             Set to false after a group enters through it or after .

fields.name: OneTimeUse
fields.summary: If OneTimeUse - automatically deactivates after players use that entry point

fields.name: DeactivateAt
fields.summary: Game time after which this entry automatically deactivates.             Prevents late joins into long-running dungeon runs.

CEDungeonInstance.name: CEDungeonInstance
CEDungeonInstance.summary: Attached to the z-network entity (or standalone map entity for non-z-network generators)             of a generated dungeon instance. Tracks instance metadata: prototype, stability,             player count, creation time, and the primary map used for player lookups.

fields.name: PrototypeId
fields.summary: The dungeon level prototype this instance was generated from.

fields.name: Stable
fields.summary: Whether this is a stable instance (singleton, always exists) or             unstable (can have multiple instances, cleaned up when empty).

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.summary: When this instance was created (game time).

fields.name: EmptySince
fields.summary: Game time when this instance first became empty (no players on any map).             Null while players are present. Used by cleanup logic to determine when to delete.

CEDungeonPassage.name: CEDungeonPassage
CEDungeonPassage.summary: Marks an entity as a dungeon level exit (portal).             Players interact with this entity to travel to the target dungeon level.             The system gathers nearby players (up to ), finds or creates             an instance of , and teleports the group there.

fields.name: TargetLevel
fields.summary: Slot number used to look up the actual target level from the owning dungeon prototype's              dictionary at activation time.             Multiple exits in the same dungeon use distinct slot numbers (1, 2, 3, ...).

fields.name: TransitionDuration
fields.summary: Time in seconds the transition takes (DoAfter duration).             During this time, dungeon generation may occur in the background.

CEAdminDungeonOverview.name: CEAdminDungeonOverview
CEAdminDungeonOverview.summary: Marker attached to entities that expose the admin dungeon overview BUI             (e.g. AdminObserver). Used to dispatch BUI messages to the system.

CEGOAPCheckHealthLevelSensor.name: CEGOAPCheckHealthLevelSensor
CEGOAPCheckHealthLevelSensor.summary: Checks if the entity's own health fraction is below a threshold.             Event-driven via CEDamageChangedEvent.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.summary: Health fraction (0..1) below which the condition is set to true.

CEGOAPCheckManaLevelSensor.name: CEGOAPCheckManaLevelSensor
CEGOAPCheckManaLevelSensor.summary: Checks if the entity's mana fraction is below a threshold.             Event-driven via CEMagicEnergyLevelChangeEvent.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.summary: Mana fraction (0..1) below which the condition is set to true.

CEGOAPHasStatusEffectSensor.name: CEGOAPHasStatusEffectSensor
CEGOAPHasStatusEffectSensor.summary: Checks if the entity has a specific status effect active.             Event-driven: reacts to CE status effect applied/removed events on this entity.

fields.name: StatusEffect
fields.summary: Prototype ID of the status effect entity to check for.

CEGOAPRangeToTargetSensor.name: CEGOAPRangeToTargetSensor
CEGOAPRangeToTargetSensor.summary: Checks if a selector-resolved target is within a specified range.

fields.name: Range
fields.summary: Range threshold in tiles.

CEGOAPTargetIsDownSensor.name: CEGOAPTargetIsDownSensor
CEGOAPTargetIsDownSensor.summary: Checks if a selector-resolved target is incapacitated (critical or dead).             Event-driven via CEGOAPTargetComponent: reacts to CEMobStateChangedEvent on tracked targets.

CEGOAPEarsPerceptor.name: CEGOAPEarsPerceptor
CEGOAPEarsPerceptor.summary: Hearing-based perception. Reacts to broadcast  and feeds             the alarm target into the knowledge store of nearby GOAP entities.             Knowledge from sound has a short lifetime — once the threat is out of earshot it fades.

fields.name: MemoryDuration
fields.summary: How long a sound-perceived entity stays in knowledge.

CEGOAPEyesPerceptor.name: CEGOAPEyesPerceptor
CEGOAPEyesPerceptor.summary: Vision-based perception. Periodically scans living mobs in radius with line-of-sight             and feeds them into the GOAP knowledge store without any faction filtering — classification             (friend/foe/etc.) is the responsibility of higher layers. Entries persist after the entity             leaves sight for up to  seconds.

fields.name: VisionRadius
fields.summary: Detection range in tiles.

fields.name: UpdateInterval
fields.summary: How often the perceptor re-scans.

fields.name: MemoryDuration
fields.summary: How long a sighted entity stays in knowledge after the last sighting.             Each new sighting refreshes the expiry.

CEGOAPPainPerceptor.name: CEGOAPPainPerceptor
CEGOAPPainPerceptor.summary: Pain perception. Whenever the NPC takes damage from a known source, that source is added             to the knowledge store. Lets mobs react to attackers they didn't visually spot first.

fields.name: MemoryDuration
fields.summary: How long an attacker stays in knowledge after the last hit.

CEGOAPKnowledgeCache.name: CEGOAPKnowledgeCache
CEGOAPKnowledgeCache.summary: Per-agent cache of classified knowledge. Maintained by              in response to . Buckets entities from              by faction relation             so consumers (sensors, selectors) don't have to rerun the predicates each tick.

CEBiomeSpawner.name: CEBiomeSpawner
CEBiomeSpawner.summary: Fills the tile in which it is located with the contents of the biome. Includes: tile, decals and entities

fields.name: MaxPressureThreshold
fields.summary: The higher-end pressure threshold. Is not considered when null.

XATTemperature.name: XATTemperature
XATTemperature.summary: This is used for an artifact that is activated by having a certain temperature near it.

fields.name: TargetTemperature
fields.summary: Threshold temperature for trigger activation.

fields.name: TriggerOnHigherTemp

CESoulDropOnDeath.name: CESoulDropOnDeath
CESoulDropOnDeath.summary: Drops a configurable number of soul shards when the entity is destroyed by             . Shards spawn at             the death position and receive a random physics impulse, matching the smooth             scatter used by CEDestructible loot drops.             Drop logic lives in  on the server.

fields.name: Souls
fields.summary: Number of soul shards to drop on death.

fields.name: Prototype
fields.summary: Prototype to spawn for each soul. Defaults to the standard soul shard.

fields.name: ScatterSpeed
fields.summary: Maximum linear speed (tiles/second) for the scatter impulse. Each shard             receives a random direction and a random speed in [0.5, ScatterSpeed],             matching the smooth physics-driven scatter used by CEDestructible loot drops.

CESoulReceiver.name: CESoulReceiver
CESoulReceiver.summary: Marks an entity as a "soul sink" that can consume a fixed amount of souls              from a player when something asks the soul system to do so.              Pure data — has no behaviour of its own. Consumer systems (e.g. blessing statue)              call  from their own interaction              handlers and listen for  on this entity.                           Concurrency / locking (one player at a time, queueing, …) is the responsibility              of the consumer system, not of this component or the soul system.

fields.name: Cost
fields.summary: Soul cost charged per successful interaction.

fields.name: Offset
fields.summary: Screen-space offset (in tile units) applied to the floating soul cost label so it can             be lifted above tall sprites such as statues. X is screen-right, Y is screen-up;

CESoulTransfer.name: CESoulTransfer
CESoulTransfer.summary: Marks a player as currently transferring souls into a receiver. Added by             ; removed once the animation duration             elapses, at which point the soul system raises CESoulReceivedEvent on the             receiver. While this component exists on a player, further TrySpendSouls             calls for that player are blocked.             Networked so the visual animation plays on every client that has the player in PVS.

fields.name: Duration
fields.summary: Total animation duration in seconds. After this elapses on the server the             transfer completes — CESoulReceivedEvent fires and the component is removed.

CEManaCoreStatusEffect.name: CEManaCoreStatusEffect
CEManaCoreStatusEffect.summary: Increases all ingoing mana restoring in X times

CEEffectOnAttackStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnAttackStatusEffect
CEEffectOnAttackStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects on melee attack targets, then remove stacks of this status effect

CEEffectOnDamagedStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnDamagedStatusEffect
CEEffectOnDamagedStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects when the entity takes damage, then remove stacks of this status effect.

CEEffectOnDamageStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnDamageStatusEffect
CEEffectOnDamageStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects to the damage target when the owner of this status effect deals damage,             optionally filtering by .             Consumes  stacks of this status effect per proc.

fields.name: AttackTypes
fields.summary: If non-empty, only trigger when the attack type matches one of these values.             Empty means trigger for all attack types.

CEEffectOnHealStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnHealStatusEffect
CEEffectOnHealStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects on entitiesss that you heals, then remove stacks of this status effect

CEEffectOnSoulReceivedStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnSoulReceivedStatusEffect
CEEffectOnSoulReceivedStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects when the entity receives souls, then remove stacks of this status effect.

CEEffectOnStatusEffectApplyStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnStatusEffectApplyStatusEffect
CEEffectOnStatusEffectApplyStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects when this entity successfully applies a status effect to a target,             then remove stacks of this status effect.             The effect target is the entity that received the status effect.             If  is empty, triggers on any status effect application.

fields.name: SourceStatusEffects
fields.summary: Filter: only trigger when one of these status effects is applied.             Leave empty to trigger on any status effect application.

CEEffectOnTileApplyStatusEffect.name: CEEffectOnTileApplyStatusEffect
CEEffectOnTileApplyStatusEffect.summary: Apply CEEntityEffects when the entity applies a tile effect, then remove stacks of this status effect.             If  is empty, triggers on any tile effect.

fields.name: SourceTileEffects
fields.summary: Filter: only trigger when one of these tile effects is applied.             Leave empty to trigger on any tile effect.

CEEffectiveHealingStatusEffect.name: CEEffectiveHealingStatusEffect
CEEffectiveHealingStatusEffect.summary: Increases all outgoing healing from the player by X

CEDivineShieldBreakEffect.name: CEDivineShieldBreakEffect
CEDivineShieldBreakEffect.summary: Applies CEEntityEffects when Divine shield breaks

fields.name: FireBonusVsFrozen
fields.summary: Bonus fire damage dealt to frozen targets.

fields.name: ColdBonusVsBurning
fields.summary: Bonus cold damage dealt to burning targets.

fields.name: FrozenEffect
fields.summary: Status effect prototype that indicates a target is frozen.

fields.name: BurningEffect
fields.summary: Status effect prototype that indicates a target is on fire.

CEChangeHealTypeStatusEffect.name: CEChangeHealTypeStatusEffect
CEChangeHealTypeStatusEffect.summary: Replaces healing with damage of the specified  damage type.

fields.name: DamageMultiplier
fields.summary: Multiplier applied to the original heal amount to calculate the damage dealt.

CESkillScanner.name: CESkillScanner
CESkillScanner.summary: Allows you to see what skills the creature possesses

CESkillStorage.name: CESkillStorage
CESkillStorage.summary: Component that stores the skills learned by a player and their progress in the skill trees.

fields.name: LearnedSkills
fields.fullType: System.Collections.Generic.List`1[[Robust.Shared.Prototypes.ProtoId`1[[Content.Shared._CE.Skill.Core.Prototypes.CESkillPrototype, Content.Shared, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]], Robust.Shared, Version=275.2.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]

CEBlessing.name: CEBlessing
CEBlessing.summary: An entity above the pedestal that you can interact with to obtain a skill for your character.

fields.name: Skill

fields.summary: What skill will the player gain from interacting with this pedestal?

fields.name: ForPlayer
fields.summary: If not null, only the specified entity can receive the skill associated with this blessing.

fields.name: MapLayer
fields.summary: Sprite layer map for visualising skill icon

fields.name: MapVFXLayer
fields.summary: Sprite layer map for visualising skill icon

fields.name: SiblingBlessings
fields.summary: Sibling blessing entities spawned alongside this one.             Used for predicted cleanup when one blessing is claimed.

CEBlessingReceiver.name: CEBlessingReceiver
CEBlessingReceiver.summary: The component allows entity to receive blessings from statues.

fields.name: ProposedSkills
fields.fullType: System.Collections.Generic.List`1[[Robust.Shared.Prototypes.ProtoId`1[[Content.Shared._CE.Skill.Core.Prototypes.CESkillPrototype, Content.Shared, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]], Robust.Shared, Version=275.2.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]
fields.summary: All skills that have been proposed to the player on any pedestal.             New statues avoid generating these to prevent cross-statue duplicates.             Cleared when the pool is exhausted and must restart.

CERandomBlessing.name: CERandomBlessing
CERandomBlessing.summary: Just set random skill into blessing upon initialization

fields.name: FalloffPower
fields.summary: The rate at which the wave fades, lower values means it's active for longer.

fields.name: Sharpness
fields.summary: How sharp the wave distortion is. Higher values make the wave more pronounced.

fields.name: Width
fields.summary: Width of the wave.

fields.name: Duration
fields.summary: How long (in seconds) the visual wave animation should last in the overlay.                 Should match the entity's TimedDespawnComponent lifetime.

CEGeneratingProceduralDungeon.name: CEGeneratingProceduralDungeon
CEGeneratingProceduralDungeon.summary: Attached to a map entity while procedural dungeon generation is in progress.             Stores the abstract room graph: room positions/sizes on a logical grid and             connections between neighbouring rooms.

fields.name: Rooms
fields.summary: All abstract rooms placed so far.

fields.name: Connections
fields.summary: Connections (edges) between rooms, stored as pairs of room indices.

CERoomPasswayMarker.name: CERoomPasswayMarker
CERoomPasswayMarker.summary: Marker component placed on room-border entities that indicate             where a passway (exit/entrance) exists in a dungeon room template.             The entity's  points             outward from the room — i.e. the direction the passage leads.

CEMapStatusEffects.name: CEMapStatusEffects
CEMapStatusEffects.summary: When attached to a map entity, applies the listed status effects             to every  that enters the map             and removes them when they leave.

CEDungeonPlayer.name: CEDungeonPlayer
CEDungeonPlayer.summary: Marker component for entities that keep a dungeon instance alive.             Added to player species prototypes (e.g. CEBaseSpeciesMob).             Only living entities with this component prevent unstable instance cleanup.             Mobs and bosses should NOT have this component.

fields.name: SessionStartedAt
fields.summary: Game time at which this player entity was initialized (round start offset).             Set server-side on MapInit; used to compute how long a player took to reach each level.

CEOneSidePassage.name: CEOneSidePassage
CEOneSidePassage.summary: One-way passage entity (like Dark Souls fog gate).             Always lets entities through from the allowed direction; always blocks from the opposite side.             Unlike turnstile, has no access check — direction alone determines passage.

fields.name: CollideExceptions
fields.summary: Maintained set of entities currently passing through (allowed through this frame).

fields.name: NextBlockTime
fields.summary: The next time at which the blocked message can show (rate-limit popups).

fields.name: BlockSound
fields.summary: Sound played when an entity is blocked.

fields.name: PassSound
fields.summary: Sound played when an entity passes through.

fields.name: DefaultState
fields.summary: Sprite layer state for idle/default appearance.

fields.name: PassState
fields.summary: Sprite layer state played when an entity passes through.

fields.name: BlockState
fields.summary: Sprite layer state played when an entity is blocked.

CENavIgnore.name: CENavIgnore
CENavIgnore.summary: Marks an entity to be ignored by NPC collision avoidance (context steering danger map).             Use on entities that are physically passable for mobs (e.g. tile effects like spikes or bushes)             that should not be treated as steering obstacles, even though they have hard fixtures.

CEMapAmbientMusicTheme.name: CEMapAmbientMusicTheme
CEMapAmbientMusicTheme.summary: Placed on a map entity to specify which ambient music prototype should play             when the local player is on that map.

fields.name: Theme
fields.fullType: System.Nullable`1[[Robust.Shared.Prototypes.ProtoId`1[[Content.Shared._CE.Music.CEAmbientMusicPrototype, Content.Shared, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]], Robust.Shared, Version=275.2.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]
fields.summary: The ambient music prototype to play on this map.             Null means no CE ambient music on this map.

CEMinimapData.name: CEMinimapData
CEMinimapData.summary: Tracks per-player minimap state for the procedural dungeon the player is currently             exploring: which rooms they have already visited and which room they are in right now.             The minimap UI on the client only renders when this component is attached to the local             player AND the player's current map (via the z-level network) carries             .

fields.name: VisitedRooms
fields.summary: Indices (in CEGeneratingProceduralDungeonComponent.Rooms) of all rooms the             player has stepped into at least once during the current dungeon run.

fields.name: CurrentRoom
fields.summary: Index of the room the player is currently inside, or null if the player             is between rooms (in a corridor / connection tile).

CEWeaponManaCost.name: CEWeaponManaCost
CEWeaponManaCost.summary: When present on a weapon entity, requires mana energy from                          on the same entity to attack. Costs are defined per .

CEMagicEnergyAmbientSound.name: CEMagicEnergyAmbientSound
CEMagicEnergyAmbientSound.summary: Turn on and off the ambient sound if entity magic powered

CEMagicEnergyContainer.name: CEMagicEnergyContainer
CEMagicEnergyContainer.summary: Allows an item to store magical energy within itself.

fields.name: Energy
fields.summary: Current available energy.

fields.name: BaseMaxEnergy
fields.summary: Base maximum energy before modifiers.             Used as the starting value for .

fields.name: MaxEnergy
fields.summary: Effective maximum energy after modifiers (flat + multipliers).             Set by .

CEMagicEnergyCrystal.name: CEMagicEnergyCrystal
CEMagicEnergyCrystal.summary: allows the object to be inserted into CEMagicEnergyCrystalSlot

CEMagicEnergyCrystalSlot.name: CEMagicEnergyCrystalSlot
CEMagicEnergyCrystalSlot.summary: Allows an entity to have a slot for inserting magic energy crystals.

CEMagicEnergyExaminable.name: CEMagicEnergyExaminable
CEMagicEnergyExaminable.summary: Allows you to examine how much energy is in that object.

CEShowMobMana.name: CEShowMobMana
CEShowMobMana.summary: When attached to an entity (directly or via equipment), enables the CE mana bar overlay             that shows mana bars above entities with .

fields.summary: Recipes this book teaches when used.

fields.name: UseDelay
fields.summary: How long reading takes (DoAfter delay).

fields.name: UseSound
fields.summary: Sound played when reading the book (page turn sound).

CERememberedNames.name: CERememberedNames
CERememberedNames.summary: Stores all the names of other characters that the player has memorized.             These players will be visible to the player under that name, rather than as nameless characters.

CEUnknownIdentity.name: CEUnknownIdentity
CEUnknownIdentity.summary: defines this character's name as unknown.             The name can be memorized via KnownNamesComponent,             and is hidden when IdentityBlocker is enabled.

CEDamageable.name: CEDamageable
CEDamageable.summary: Stores accumulated damage per type for an entity.

CEDamageOnLand.name: CEDamageOnLand
CEDamageOnLand.summary: Applies CE damage to the entity when it lands after being thrown.             Used for fragile items like throwable potions.             Requires  on the same entity.

fields.name: Damage
fields.summary: Amount of CE damage applied on landing.

CEDamagePopup.name: CEDamagePopup
CEDamagePopup.summary: Marker component that enables floating damage/heal number popups above an entity.

CEDestructibleAnimation.name: CEDestructibleAnimation
CEDestructibleAnimation.summary: When present, the entity will play a death animation before being destroyed.             On a fatal hit,  is cancelled and the animation starts.             Once the animation finishes, the entity is destroyed via the normal pipeline.

fields.name: Animation
fields.summary: The animation to play on death before the entity is destroyed.

CEDestructible.name: CEDestructible
CEDestructible.summary: Destroys the entity (QueueDel) when accumulated damage reaches the threshold.             For entities with , the threshold is counted             only after they have entered Critical.

fields.name: DestroyThreshold
fields.summary: Damage value at or above which the entity is destroyed.             For entities with , this is the amount of             extra damage they can take after reaching Critical.

CEMobState.name: CEMobState
CEMobState.summary: Stores mob state thresholds and the current state.             When damage reaches , the entity enters Critical.

fields.name: BaseMaxHealth
fields.summary: Base maximum health before modifiers.             Used as the starting value for .

fields.name: CriticalThreshold
fields.summary: Effective maximum health after modifiers (flat + multipliers).             Damage at or above this value causes the entity to enter Critical state.             Set by .

CEShowMobHealth.name: CEShowMobHealth
CEShowMobHealth.summary: When attached to an entity (directly or via equipment), enables the CE health bar overlay             that shows health bars above mobs with  or GOAP AI.

CEActiveGOAP.name: CEActiveGOAP
CEActiveGOAP.summary: Marker component for active GOAP-controlled NPCs.             Added by CEGOAPSystem when the NPC should be actively updated.

CEGOAP.name: CEGOAP
CEGOAP.summary: CrystallEdge GOAP NPC Component. Contains goals, available actions, and sensors             for goal-oriented action planning AI.

fields.name: StartSleeping
fields.summary: When true, the entity spawns in a sleeping state (with )             and must be explicitly woken by a trigger (damage, proximity, etc.).

fields.name: Goals
fields.summary: List of goals this entity can pursue.

fields.name: Actions
fields.summary: Available actions this entity can perform.

fields.name: PlanCooldown
fields.summary: Time between re-planning attempts.

fields.name: NextPlanTime
fields.summary: The next game time at which re-planning is allowed.

fields.name: WakeRadius
fields.summary: Radius within which a player's presence will wake this entity.

CEGOAPTarget.name: CEGOAPTarget
CEGOAPTarget.summary: Added to entities that are currently classified as an enemy by some GOAP agent's             knowledge cache. Used for event-based target sensors (mob state changed) and to let             clients detect when the local player is being hunted.             Automatically managed by  classifier.             Networked so clients can react.

CEEquipStatusEffect.name: CEEquipStatusEffect
CEEquipStatusEffect.summary: When this component is on a clothing item, equipping the item applies             the specified status effect (as 1 stack) to the wearer. Unequipping removes it.

CEEphemeralCollectable.name: CEEphemeralCollectable
CEEphemeralCollectable.summary: An entity that can be "collected" by each dungeon player independently.             Existing as a single shared world entity, it grants its              to every              that touches it (once per player).             On the client, the entity becomes locally invisible for players who already collected it,             even though it still exists on the server for everyone else.

fields.name: Effects
fields.summary: Effects applied to a player on first contact.

fields.name: CollectedBy
fields.summary: Players (entities) that have already collected this from their perspective.             Server-authoritative, networked so each client can hide it locally.

fields.name: CollectVfx
fields.summary: Optional client-side VFX entity spawned at the collectable's position the moment             the local player collects it. Client-only spawn -> instant feedback, no server lag.

fields.name: CollectSound
fields.summary: Optional sound played predictively at the collectable's position when a player collects it.             Predicted = local player hears it instantly via prediction; the server confirms for everyone else.

fields.name: CollectionDelay
fields.summary: Grace period after spawn during which the collectable cannot be picked up. Gives the             client time to receive the entity state, run scatter animations, and lets the player             actually see the drop instead of auto-collecting it on contact a single tick later.

fields.name: CollectableAt
fields.summary: Server-authoritative timestamp at which this collectable becomes collectable. Set             during map init to CurTime + CollectionDelay. Networked so prediction agrees             with the server about the grace cutoff.

CEEntityEffectOnCollide.name: CEEntityEffectOnCollide
CEEntityEffectOnCollide.summary: Applies a list of  to entities that collide with this entity.             Handled server-side by CEEntityEffectOnCollideSystem.

CEDestructionEffect.name: CEDestructionEffect
CEDestructionEffect.summary: Applies effects from  list at the destruction point             via  (raised by ).

fields.name: Effects
fields.summary: Effects applied at the destruction point.             Use  to target entities around the point.

CEDPSMeter.name: CEDPSMeter
CEDPSMeter.summary: Add to an entity to track incoming damage-per-second and total damage.             The shared system accumulates data from ;             the client overlay reads the networked fields and computes a live decreasing DPS display.

fields.name: MaxDPS
fields.summary: Maximum DPS reached during the current tracking session.             Top line of the overlay: "Max: X.X".

fields.name: TotalDamage
fields.summary: Total accumulated damage since tracking started.             Used by the client overlay to compute the live DPS: TotalDamage / elapsed.

fields.name: StartTrackTime
fields.summary: Game time when the current tracking session started.             Networked so the client can compute elapsed time independently.

fields.name: LastHitTime
fields.summary: Game time of the last received hit.             The client uses this to drive the fade-out: after  of             silence the overlay fades over  then the session resets.

fields.name: Offset
fields.summary: Screen-space offset in tile units. Y+ is screen-up.

fields.name: TrackTimeAfterHit
fields.summary: How long after the last hit before the overlay starts fading.

fields.name: FadeDuration
fields.summary: Duration of the fade-out animation. After this the session resets.

CECurrencyExaminable.name: CECurrencyExaminable
CECurrencyExaminable.summary: Allows you to estimate the value of an item with a simple glance.

CEAutoConveyor.name: CEAutoConveyor
CEAutoConveyor.summary: Marker that auto-activates an existing              on MapInit (sets state to Forward and powered to true).

fields.name: Effects
fields.summary: Effects applied to the target when the item is consumed.

fields.name: UseDelay
fields.summary: How long the DoAfter takes when using on yourself.

fields.name: OtherUseDelayMultiplier
fields.summary: Multiplier applied to  when using on another entity.

fields.name: UseSound
fields.summary: Sound played when the item is consumed.

fields.name: ReplacementEntity
fields.summary: If set, spawns this entity at the item's position when the item is consumed or depleted.             For example, an empty vial after drinking a potion.             If null, the item is simply deleted when depleted.

fields.name: Whitelist
fields.summary: If set, only entities matching this whitelist can be targeted by this consumable.

fields.name: Blacklist
fields.summary: If set, entities matching this blacklist cannot be targeted by this consumable.

fields.name: SingleUse
fields.summary: If false, the item is not deleted after use and can be consumed repeatedly.             Defaults to true (single-use behavior).

CEScreenshake.name: CEScreenshake
CEScreenshake.summary: Marks an entity which is actively screenshaking because of a screenshake command being given.

fields.name: Commands
fields.summary: A set of screenshake commands which this entity is currently processing.                 Trauma is 0..1, with 0 being no shake and 1 being maximum shake.

CEBossHealthBar.name: CEBossHealthBar
CEBossHealthBar.summary: Causes a boss health bar UI widget to appear for nearby clients when this entity is in their PVS range.

CEBonfire.name: CEBonfire
CEBonfire.summary: Marks an entity as a bonfire that dungeon players can interact with.             Each player may use the bonfire exactly once; on use, a              is raised on the player entity.

fields.name: UsedBy
fields.summary: Player entities that have already used this bonfire.             Networked so the client can update the sprite overlay when the local player is in the list.

fields.name: UsedOverlayLayer
fields.summary: Key of the sprite layer to hide once the local player has used this bonfire.

fields.name: HealVfx
fields.summary: Entity prototype spawned at the player's position when the bonfire heals them.

fields.name: HealSound
fields.summary: Sound played at the player's position when the bonfire heals them.

CEBlinker.name: CEBlinker
CEBlinker.summary: Makes a character blink. That's it.

CEEmitSoundOnStackMerge.name: CEEmitSoundOnStackMerge
CEEmitSoundOnStackMerge.summary: Plays a sound when two stacks are merged together.

ItemMapper.name: ItemMapper
ItemMapper.summary: ItemMapperComponent is a  that maps string labels to an  of elements. Useful primarily  for visualization.             To define a mapping, create a mapLayers map in configuration ItemMapper component and with  mapping.             Each map layer maps layer name to an , plus special modifiers for min and max item count.             Min and max count are useful when you need to visualize a certain number of items, for example, to display one, two, three, or more items.                          If you need a more straightforward way to change appearance where only variable is how many items, rather than which items             and how many, see              For a contrived example, create a tool-belt with a Power drill slot and two light bulb slots.             To use this for visualization, we need  a or VisualizerSystem, e.g.                            - type: Appearance                  visuals:                  - type: MappedItemVisualizer                          To map Powerdrill to the given example, we need the following code.                          - type: ItemMapper               mapLayers:                 drill:                   whitelist:                     tags:                     - Powerdrill             #... to be continued                          To map Lightbulb (not tag) to two different layers (for one and two light bulbs, respectively)                          #... to be continued                 lightbulb1:                   minCount: 1                   whitelist:                     component:                     - Lightbulb                 lightbulb2:                   minCount: 2                   whitelist:                     component:                     - Lightbulb                          The min count will ensure that lightbulb1 layer is only displayed when one or more light bulbs are in the belt.             And lightbulb2 layer will only be shown when two or more light bulbs are inserted.

PAI.name: PAI
PAI.summary: pAIs, or Personal AIs, are essentially portable ghost role generators.             In their current implementation in SS14, they create a ghost role anyone can access,             and that a player can also "wipe" (reset/kick out player).             Theoretically speaking pAIs are supposed to use a dedicated "offer and select" system,              with the player holding the pAI being able to choose one of the ghosts in the round.             This seems too complicated for an initial implementation, though,              and there's not always enough players and ghost roles to justify it.             All logic in PAISystem.

CEDamageVisuals.name: CEDamageVisuals
CEDamageVisuals.summary: Displays damage overlay sprites on humanoid body parts based on the             damage fraction, using .             Simplified port of the vanilla DamageVisualsComponent without per-group             damage tracking.

fields.name: Thresholds
fields.summary: Damage fraction thresholds (0–1) representing percentage of max health.             A zeroth threshold is automatically added. Sorted on init.             Example: [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]             means overlays appear at 10%, 20%, 30%, 50%, 70%, and 100% damage.

fields.name: TargetLayers
fields.summary: Layers to target by their layer map key (e.g. HumanoidVisualLayers enum values).             One overlay layer is created per target layer.

fields.name: Sprite
fields.summary: RSI path containing damage overlay states.             States should be named {LayerName}_{StatePrefix}_{Suffix},             where Suffix = round(Threshold x ThresholdMultiplier).             Example: Chest_Brute_3 for threshold 0.3 with multiplier 10.

fields.name: Color
fields.summary: Optional overlay color (hex).

fields.name: StatePrefix
fields.summary: Prefix inserted between the layer name and the threshold suffix             in the RSI state name: {LayerName}_{StatePrefix}_{Suffix}.

fields.name: ThresholdMultiplier
fields.summary: Multiplier to convert fractional thresholds to RSI state suffixes.             State suffix = round(threshold × this value).             Example: threshold 0.3, multiplier 10 -> suffix "3".

Min and max count are useful when you need to visualize a certain number of items, for example, to display one, two, three, or more items.                          If you need a more straightforward way to change appearance where only variable is how many items, rather than which items             and how many, see              For a contrived example, create a tool-belt with a Power drill slot and two light bulb slots.             To use this for visualization, we need  a or VisualizerSystem, e.g.                            - type: Appearance                  visuals:                  - type: MappedItemVisualizer                          To map Powerdrill to the given example, we need the following code.                          - type: ItemMapper               mapLayers:                 drill:                   whitelist:                     tags:                     - Powerdrill             #... to be continued                          To map Lightbulb (not tag) to two different layers (for one and two light bulbs, respectively)                          #... to be continued                 lightbulb1:                   minCount: 1                   whitelist:                     component:                     - Lightbulb                 lightbulb2:                   minCount: 2                   whitelist:                     component:                     - Lightbulb                          The min count will ensure that lightbulb1 layer is only displayed when one or more light bulbs are in the belt. Content.Shared.Damage.ForceSay.AllowNext.summary: The reason for this component's existence is slightly unintuitive, so for context: this is put on an entity                  to allow its next speech attempt to bypass  checks. The reason for this is to allow                  'force saying'--for instance, with deathgasping or with .                               This component is either removed in the  speech attempt check, or after                   has passed. This is to allow a player-submitted forced message in the case of ,                  while also ensuring that it isn't valid forever. It has to work this way, because the server is not a keylogger and doesn't                  have any knowledge of what the client might actually have typed, so it gives them some leeway for ping.

Content.Client._CE.Damage.CEDamageVisual.summary: Displays damage overlay sprites on humanoid body parts based on the             damage fraction, using .             Simplified port of the vanilla DamageVisualsComponent without per-group             damage tracking.

fields.name: Thresholds
fields.summary: Damage fraction thresholds (0–1) representing percentage of max health.             A zeroth threshold is automatically added. Sorted on init.             Example: [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]             means overlays appear at 10%, 20%, 30%, 50%, 70%, and 100% damage.

fields.name: TargetLayers
fields.summary: Layers to target by their layer map key (e.g. HumanoidVisualLayers enum values).             One overlay layer is created per target layer.

fields.name: Sprite
fields.summary: RSI path containing damage overlay states.             States should be named {LayerName}_{StatePrefix}_{Suffix},             where Suffix = round(Threshold x ThresholdMultiplier).             Example: Chest_Brute_3 for threshold 0.3 with multiplier 10.

fields.name: Color
fields.summary: Optional overlay color (hex).

fields.name: StatePrefix
fields.summary: Prefix inserted between the layer name and the threshold suffix             in the RSI state name: {LayerName}_{StatePrefix}_{Suffix}.

fields.name: ThresholdMultiplier
fields.summary: Multiplier to convert fractional thresholds to RSI state suffixes.             State suffix = round(threshold × this value).             Example: threshold 0.3, multiplier 10 -> suffix "3".

fields.name: Texture

fields.name: Scale
fields.summary: A scaling factor for the texture.             In the interest of simplifying maths, this is rounded down to integer for ParallaxControl, so be careful.

fields.name: Tiled
fields.summary: If true, this layer is tiled as the camera scrolls around.             If false, this layer only shows up around it's home position.

fields.name: ControlHomePosition
fields.summary: A position relative to the centre of a ParallaxControl that this parallax should be drawn at, in pixels.             Used for menus.             Note that this is ignored if the parallax layer is tiled - in that event a random pixel offset is used and slowness is applied.

fields.name: WorldHomePosition
fields.summary: The "relative to ParallaxAnchor" starting world position for this layer.             Essentially, an unclamped lerp occurs between here and the eye position, with Slowness as the factor.             Used for in-game.

fields.name: WorldAdjustPosition
fields.summary: An adjustment performed to the world position of this layer after parallax shifting.             Used for in-game.             Useful for moving around Slowness = 1.0 objects (which can't otherwise be moved from screen centre).

fields.name: Slowness
fields.summary: Multiplier of parallax shift.             A slowness of 0.0f anchors this layer to the world.             A slowness of 1.0f anchors this layer to the camera.

fields.name: Scrolling
fields.summary: Should the parallax scroll at a specific rate per second.
